# PR Review Guidelines

- Treat this file as the repo-local policy for automated PR review.
- Point out changes that do not match the current folder structure, naming, or module boundaries.
- Mention missing tests when behavior changes or bug fixes are introduced.
- Avoid style-only feedback unless it affects readability or maintenance.
- Prefer one clear summary comment over many noisy comments when the same issue repeats.

# Notes

- This starter uses the stock OpenCode GitHub Action flow.
- By default, comments come from `github-actions[bot]` unless you later swap to a GitHub App based integration.
